Ceyhun Birinci (Artegra Type)
items.description: Artegra is a type foundry run by Turkish type designer Ceyhun Birinci. He studied graphic design at Marmara University in Istanbul, the typography classes he took marked the beginning of his interest in typeface design. He created his first font Primus back in 2012, which had started as a part of his personal branding project.
